$comment: Zeporah production-readiness tracker. Statuses: open, in_progress, evidence_submitted, closed, accepted_with_control (pilot conditions only). A gap is closed only with non-document evidence and every approver's signed approval; run `bun scripts/readiness-check.ts`.

items.title: No git repository, protected source control, CI, release pipeline or controlled deployment
items.artifact: Git repository; branch protection; PR template; CI workflow; release checklist; environment matrix
items.verification: CI green on a sample change; a non-production rollback drill
items.evidenceRequired: Repository policy; CI run links; rollback drill record
items.closureCriteria: Every change reaches staging only through a reviewed PR with green CI, and a rollback was drilled

items.title: No production hosting, managed database, environment isolation, secrets manager, monitoring or release governance
items.verification: Configuration review; health and uptime checks firing
items.evidenceRequired: Architecture diagram; vendor BAA status; reviewed production configuration
items.closureCriteria: Staging and pilot run on a managed, BAA-covered platform, separate from demo

items.title: No backup and restore program or restore drills
items.verification: One restore drill to an isolated environment (two before Stage 2)
items.evidenceRequired: Backup configuration; drill report with recovery time and data checked
items.closureCriteria: A restore from backup was completed and verified within the agreed time

items.title: No threat model
items.verification: Review session with the privacy and security officer
items.evidenceRequired: Threat model with owners and mitigations, each linked to a control or an accepted risk
items.closureCriteria: Every high threat has a control or a signed acceptance

items.title: No security-header baseline
items.artifact: Header policy (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy)
items.verification: Automated header tests on every route type; a scan of staging
items.closureCriteria: Every response carries the policy, and tests fail if one is missing

items.title: No CSRF defence beyond SameSite cookies
items.artifact: CSRF design for every state-changing request (an origin check in the `run` wrapper, plus a token or fetch-metadata check)
items.verification: Negative tests: cross-site POSTs refused for every write path
items.closureCriteria: No state change succeeds from a foreign origin, by test

items.title: Rate limiting is per account only
items.artifact: Rate-limit design by account, session, network and endpoint sensitivity
items.verification: Abuse tests (credential stuffing, invitation guessing, export bursts)
items.closureCriteria: Limits hold under test and raise an alert

items.title: No staff MFA or identity-provider architecture
items.artifact: `architecture/authentication.md`; identity provider integration; mandatory staff MFA
items.verification: Sign-in without MFA refused; termination test (access ends at once)
items.closureCriteria: No staff session exists without MFA

items.title: No tenant and organization boundary validation plan for a real Postgres server
items.artifact: Tenant isolation test plan on managed Postgres
items.verification: Authorization and tenant-isolation suite against staging
items.evidenceRequired: Suite results on the pilot database engine
items.closureCriteria: Cross-tenant and cross-household access is refused in every tested path on the real engine

items.title: Plaintext database files; no encryption-at-rest architecture
items.artifact: Encryption at rest and in transit; key management
items.closureCriteria: All pilot data and backups encrypted with managed keys

items.title: No approved retention, deletion or lifecycle policy (R-10)
items.artifact: Retention and deletion policy (including backups and legal holds)
items.verification: Deletion job tested on synthetic data
items.evidenceRequired: Policy approved by counsel; test results
items.closureCriteria: Approved policy, and the product follows it in test

items.title: Staff reads of household information aren't audited
items.artifact: Read-access logging in the `run` wrapper for household reads; audit event inventory
items.verification: Tests: every household read writes one event; staff-only visibility
items.evidenceRequired: Inventory; test results; audit review procedure
items.closureCriteria: Every staff read of household information is logged and reviewable

items.title: No incident or breach response plan
items.artifact: `runbooks/incident-breach.md`; notification decision path agreed with the hospice
items.closureCriteria: A tabletop was run and its gaps closed

items.title: No HIPAA privacy and security program, BAAs, vendor assessments, legal review or clinical-content governance
items.artifact: HIPAA program documents; vendor and BAA register; pilot agreement; clinical-content governance charter
items.evidenceRequired: Signed BAAs; reviewed agreement; issue register
items.closureCriteria: Agreements signed and counsel's open issues closed or accepted

items.title: No support, onboarding, training, escalation or change-management model; pilot cap not enforced
items.artifact: Pilot operations manual; training; support runbook; cap control
items.verification: Escalation drill; cap test (the 26th household is refused)
items.evidenceRequired: Training completion; drill record; test results
items.closureCriteria: Staff trained, support staffed, cap enforced

items.title: No manual accessibility validation with assistive-technology and stressed users
items.artifact: Manual accessibility protocol run; usability sessions; remediation tracker
items.verification: Sessions with assistive-technology users and caregivers on critical workflows
items.closureCriteria: No open critical accessibility finding on a critical workflow

items.title: Documentation drift (readiness documents behind the code)
items.artifact: Corrected readiness documents; a documentation check in CI
items.closureCriteria: Readiness documents match the code; CI checks links
items.note: Documents corrected against the code. Still needs a documentation link check in CI (after D-01).

items.title: English only for safety, consent and boundary wording
items.closureCriteria: A written compensating control, signed by the founder and the compliance reviewer, or the gap closed

items.title: Email: none in Stage 1 unless decided (invitations passed by hand)
items.closureCriteria: A written compensating control, signed by the founder and the compliance reviewer, or the gap closed

items.title: One role per staff member; one household per family account
items.closureCriteria: A written compensating control, signed by the founder and the compliance reviewer, or the gap closed

items.title: Operations and reviewers see every household in their hospice
items.closureCriteria: A written compensating control, signed by the founder and the compliance reviewer, or the gap closed

items.title: 30-day "Remember me" family sessions (decision 53) on shared devices
items.closureCriteria: A written compensating control, signed by the founder and the compliance reviewer, or the gap closed

items.title: Independent penetration test
items.closureCriteria: Closed with evidence before Stage 2

items.title: Database row-level security as a second wall
items.closureCriteria: Closed with evidence before Stage 2

items.title: Two consecutive successful restore drills
items.closureCriteria: Closed with evidence before Stage 2

items.title: Audit chain anchored outside the database
items.closureCriteria: Closed with evidence before Stage 2
